task_text: I'm heading to bed in 15 minutes. The house should be quiet and settled — lights down, things put away, and the bedroom ready to sleep in.

central_instructions.R1: Turn off the kitchen lights and ensure all light objects are put away.
central_instructions.R2: Turn off the living room lights and tidy up any light objects.
central_instructions.R3: Prepare the bedroom for sleep by turning off the lights, tidying up, and ensuring the bed is ready.
central_instructions.R4: Turn off the bathroom lights and ensure any light objects are put away.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the cup from the sink basin. (r1_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the cup in the cupboard. (r1_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the egg from the sink basin. (r1_s3)
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the egg in the fridge. (r1_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Turn off the kitchen lights. (r1_s5)
agent_plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Turn off the floor lamp in the living room. (r2_s1)
- R2 [LOCAL] Pick up any light objects (e.g., remote control) from the sofa. (r2_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Place the light objects in their designated spots (e.g., remote control on the coffee table). (r2_s3)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Turn off the table lamp near the window. (r2_s4)
agent_plans.R3:
[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Turn off the desk lamp. (r3_s1)
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up any light objects on the floor and place them on the desk. (r3_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Push the chair under the desk to tidy up. (r3_s3)
- R3 [LOCAL] Ensure the bed is neatly arranged and the blanket is straightened. (r3_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Turn off the main room light. (r3_s5)
- R3 [LOCAL] Close the window blinds for privacy. (r3_s6)
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Pick up the cloth from the bathtub basin. (r4_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Place the cloth in the cabinet. (r4_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Turn off the bathroom lights. (r4_s3)
